task.title: Sort Library rows
task.shortdesc: Sort saved profiles by update time, creation time, name, schema channel, or ID in ascending or descending order.

prereq.p: The Library is open and contains at least two visible profile rows.

context.p: Sorting changes the row order inside the current search and filter result.

step.cmd: Select the field to sort by.

info.p: Expected result: rows reorder by updated time, created time, name, schema, or ID.
Use descending updated time for recent work or ascending name for alphabetic browsing.

step.cmd: Check the filtered and total counts before acting on the first row.

info.note: Sorting does not remove filters. A row can still be hidden by search or filters.

result.p: The visible Library rows appear in the selected order.

postreq.p: Recovery: switch back to updated-time sorting if the row order no longer matches your work context.
